confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Kunming's price level as a lower-cost provincial capital; restaurant anchors are more reliable than accommodation, and cocktail and wine are less certain. Cocktail and wine were set relative to beer and restaurant pricing because direct knowledge is weak. The FX value comes from a search summary of the RBA exchange-rate table and was not confirmed by opening the live page.
comparable_city_reasoning: Compared with other mid-sized Chinese provincial capitals with similar tourism demand and lower restaurant and hotel costs than Tier-1 cities such as Beijing or Shanghai. Prices assume ordinary venues in July 2026.
